title: Authenticated equal-bound honesty decision
objective: Compute the authentic h=1 cubic equal-bound honesty skip directly from authenticated factor-base bounds, with ordinary Python and mutation tests

handoff.summary: Added an ordinary-Python honesty dispatch component that consumes the resident preparation's authenticated seven-word factor-base state and connected preparation state. It derives the authentic h=1 cubic skip by evaluating PARI 2.17.4's exact KCZ2 > KCZ predicate; no status or result bit is accepted. Mutation tests switch equal counts to required honesty, reject disconnected counters and invalid monotonicity, and preserve inputs on failure.
risks: This closes only equal-count dispatch; it does not implement or certify unequal-bound be_honest.
Authentication authority remains the upstream resident preparation that produces and cross-checks the bound state.
next_steps: Replace downstream literal equal-bound-source-skip labels with this derived component when the integration lane can claim those consumers.
